rule_text: The commit message body explains why the change was made, naming the failure mode and the rationale.
notes: Issue #175 — inverse of target-kind-mismatch-01. A commit-message rule evaluated against a PR-description artifact must return `unsupported` AND its primary_reason must reference `commit_message` (the rule's annotated kind), not 'PR descriptions'. v3 regressed: gpt-4o-mini parroted 'The rule addresses PR descriptions' verbatim regardless of the rule's annotation; v4 grounds the kind name.
